review.summary: Across all batch reviews, the film demonstrates a solid Statistico regression structure: there is a substantive overview, three clear analytical demonstrations, a staged catalogue, and a compliant close. Technical and visual standards, gold highlight overlay timing per logs, and scene coverage (overview, action, consequence, catalogue, close) are all confirmed as present and correct. However, all reviews detect a required issue: a long, unexplained silence of roughly 30 seconds during the main catalogue card (approx. 86–117s). This section is not an intentional silent card, and regression module standards require narration introducing the catalogue (e.g., “These demonstrations are part of a broader regression toolkit”) with guidance and suitable pacing for viewers to read. No batch observes catalogue narration or a visual indication that silence is intended. No other technical or content block is found. This gap must be addressed before human review or release.

evidence: All batches: measured silence/no narration from approx. 86s–117s during the catalogue section; no transcript, waveform, or visual cue for intentional silence; no narration introducing or guiding feature reading as required by regression film standards.
issues.observed: Extended, unexplained silence (~30s) during the catalogue scene; no required narration present, and no silent card indicator.
issues.requested_change: Add the required narration introducing the Regression feature catalogue (e.g., “These demonstrations are part of a broader regression toolkit”), leave enough time for reading all catalogue items, and ensure no long unexplained silence remains. If silence is intentional (not standard for Regression), visually indicate this for the user.
issues.acceptance_check: Catalogue scene includes narrated introduction and guidance as per Regression standards, with any silence visually explained. No unexplained, extended silence remains.

unassessed_checks: Sampling alone cannot verify overlay animation timings (300ms draw, 2.4s breathe, 200ms fade); confirmation relies on logs and encoded settings.
Sampling of transcript or frames cannot fully assess voiceover naturalness, pronunciation, music/noise absence, or transition polish—human review is required for these checks.
